sources.OA-1095: September 2, 2026 route-stop snapshot used only for stop coordinates

filters: core OD has both codes in Seoul ADMI_202608

calculations.monthly_sum: sum(cnt) over retained aggregate rows; missing cnt is excluded, never replaced by zero
calculations.daily_average: weekday monthly subtotal / 22; weekend monthly subtotal / 8
calculations.concentration_share: dong estimated movement sum / all internal-Seoul dong sum within hour
calculations.candidate_rule: top 100 distinct-dong internal-Seoul OD-hour cells by OA-22300 weekday plus weekend monthly estimated movement sum; intrazonal cells retained only in intrazonal_summary.csv
calculations.bus_candidate_rule: top 100 stops by sum of OA-12913 03,04,05 monthly boardings plus alightings

non_additivity: OA-22300 purpose and OA-22657 mode totals are parallel axes; OA-12913 has a different unit and is not differenced.
